title: Cozy Studio for 2, Highly Walkable + Close to DT!
description:
✔️ South Nashville location — minutes to Downtown and Broadway
✔️ Community pool for relaxing between adventures
✔️ Studio-style apartment, 1 bathroom — sleeps up to 2
✔️ Queen bed with dedicated workspace
✔️ Full kitchen and high-speed WiFi
✔️ Free parking for up to 2 vehicles

The space
• Comfortable apartment designed for couples and solo travelers
• Bright living space with dedicated workspace and high-speed WiFi
• Full kitchen for easy meals before exploring Nashville
• Community pool for cooling off after a day in the city
• Perfect for weekend getaways, business trips, and extended stays

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Comfortable living area
• Dedicated workspace
• High-speed WiFi
• Community outdoor swimming pool

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 2)
• This home includes 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom.
• Bedroom — Queen bed
• Bath — Single vanity with shower/tub combo

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with basic cookware and serveware
• Full-size appliances
• Cookware, dishes, utensils, and glassware provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• High-speed WiFi
• Dedicated workspace
• Community pool access
• We provide bedding, towels, and a small starter set of essentials

📍 Location Highlights
• South Nashville location with easy access to Downtown
• Minutes to Broadway and Bridgestone Arena
• Close to restaurants, shopping, and live music
• Convenient access to Nashville's top attractions

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Stairs: Stairs are required to access the unit (please review photos for reference).
• Parking: Lot and street parking are available for up to 2 vehicles on a first-come, first-served basis. Only park in the building lot or designated street spaces. Do not park in the neighboring liquor store or restaurant lots, as those lots tow non-customer vehicles.
• This home is not pet friendly. If there is found evidence of an animal's presence during your stay or post check-out, guests will be charged an additional cleaning fee.
• Community amenities: Guests have access to the community pool. Availability and hours are managed by the building.
• Check in is at 4:00 PM and checkout is at 10:00 AM.
